doc: Known nano-vs-Zeebe trace divergences. Each entry: {scenario, issue: "#N", reason, ignoreRecords?, nanoTrace?}. A listed scenario that no longer diverges is STALE and fails engine-core/tests/zeebe_traces.rs — delete it. `ignoreRecords` (record-field matchers) narrows the entry: only matching records may differ; every other record of every step must still equal Zeebe. `nanoTrace` (#1521) pins the fingerprint of nano's divergent trace: any change in nano's behaviour on that scenario fails until re-reviewed and re-pinned; generated-budget (g-*) entries must carry it (or ignoreRecords).
